request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:THRALL

layers.text: Redraw him as a dazed mind-controlled soldier, same size: slumped, both arms hanging down, no shield; a plain drab mid-grey tunic and trousers, nothing red or gold; a pale grey face with two empty white eyes; instead of his helmet a polished chrome control helmet with a short antenna and one glowing hot magenta light; a dark gunmetal collar; a dull grey short sword hanging low in one hand. Keep the proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
